description: Read a company website for environmental claims and greenwashing risk under EU Directive 2024/825 (from 27 Sep 2026) and the UK CMA Green Claims Code, find evidence and credentials (SBTi, ISO 14001, B Corp, reports), and measure the site's own footprint (green hosting, carbon.txt, page weight, CO2 per view).
name: green_claims_scan
title: Green claims & sustainability credentials scan
